figure_contract.core_conclusion_6uon: Partner context selectively suppresses the model's predicted mobility at the contacted central KRAS-G12D peptide ridge, while MD retains p6/p8 as the most mobile ridge positions.
figure_contract.core_conclusion_2ptt: The 2B4-CD48 interface combines relatively stable electrostatic anchors with a bound CC-prime loop that remains locally compliant.
figure_contract.journal_export: Nature-family standard, 183 mm double-column, vector PDF/SVG plus 300 dpi PNG

6uon_peptide.md_replica_definition: Per-residue C-alpha RMSF averaged over three independent ITrace trajectories after chain-wise fitting.

2ptt_local.dataset_role: DynaRepo model-selection validation example; not an untouched external test.
2ptt_local.h42_mapping: Native 2B4 H42 is present in 2PTT/2PTU coordinates but absent from the DynaRepo residue prediction table; it is masked, not assigned zero.

model.checkpoint_role: Frozen pretraining checkpoint used for ITrace and DynaRepo state prediction.

statistics_and_reproducibility.inferential_tests: None. These are residue-level mechanistic case studies, not independent-replicate hypothesis tests.
statistics_and_reproducibility.center_and_spread: No error bars are plotted in the case panels. The 6UON MD target is the mean of three trajectories at each residue; the 2PTT target is the archived DynaRepo RMSF label.
statistics_and_reproducibility.selection_rule: Residues in quantitative local panels were selected before plotting from published structural contacts and named CC-prime loops; every mapped residue remains in the source-data tables and whole-structure coloring.
